AgeGroup.description: An age band of the norm table, whole years inclusive; `max_age` None = open.
AgeGroup.title: AgeGroup

NormBracket.description: A verbal band of the final score: the highest bracket with `min` <= score.
NormBracket.title: NormBracket

NormComposite.description:
A composite = the sum of its sections' SCALED scores (e.g. "I" = odd subtests),
or with `basis="raw"` the sum of their RAW scores (e.g. Amthauer V = T1..T4; a
composite may span every section, G = all nine). Its sum is looked up in
`by_age` (when loaded) like a scaled sum.

basis.description: 'scaled' = sum of the sections' scaled scores (needs their scaled tables); 'raw' = sum of their raw scores (no scaled table needed).
basis.title: Basis

NormComposite.title: NormComposite

NormRow.description:
One row of the sum -> score table: the composite's scaled-score SUM and the
score per age group (`values[group_key]`).
NormRow.title: NormRow

description:
Generic norm-referenced scoring (`app/grading/norm_scoring.py`).

per-section raw -> scaled (`scaled_tables[section_id]`, or the age group's own
table in `scaled_tables_by_age`) -> composite sums (scaled, or raw with
`basis="raw"`) -> composite score by age (`by_age`) -> final
(`mean_of_composites`, or one composite's score with `final="composite"`) ->
bracket. Authoring-only: never in `ClientTest` (tables are the test's key).

Every table is optional: a test whose norms are not loaded yet (e.g. a test
supplied without its manual) has `by_age=None` — the report then carries raw
sums, % of maximum and the note `no_norm_tables`, and no IQ. A later age table
(IST style: subtest raw -> standard score per age group, then the total -> IQ)
is added by filling `scaled_tables_by_age` + `by_age` (+ `final="composite"`
on the total), without touching the items.

by_age.description: Composite sum -> score per age group. None = norms not loaded (raw report only).

final_composite.description: With final='composite': the key of the composite whose score is the overall (e.g. the total G -> IQ).
final_composite.title: Final Composite

scaled_tables.description: section_id -> raw bands (ascending, no gaps / overlaps), the same for every age.
scaled_tables.title: Scaled Tables

scaled_tables_by_age.description: age group key -> section_id -> raw bands: per-age standard scores (IST style). For the student's age group they take precedence over `scaled_tables`.
scaled_tables_by_age.title: Scaled Tables By Age
